svg.title: Empire (transversal) interlock network

g.text: Forges et aciéries du Nord et de l'Est

svg.text: 14 firms in 6 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 389 firms, 1,514 interlocks, 7 components (largest 375). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 108 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
